decisions.reason: The online customer portal was a deliberate digital investment outside the firm's core, it supports the announced deeper customer collaboration and information-security direction, and it is too new to judge, so management will persist with it.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a highly visible public commitment that validates the firm's innovation claim, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits at the core of the display business and has its own web page, and any weak results can be attributed to the launch phase, so it stays.
The small counter display is close to the established offer, cheap to maintain and publicly presented, which supports keeping it.
The large freestanding information display fits the announced broader 3D cardboard offering and is visibly presented, so management keeps it.
